title: Index of a Word Tape
statement: For natural numbers $v$, $i$, and $p$, and an index $j$ with $0 \le j < 3$, define the corresponding word-tape index to be $j$ in the set of tape indices $\{0,1,\ldots,2v+2i+2p+2\}$.
